sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter Five Intersections and turns

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
Left turns bow to straight and right traffic while simultaneous-stop corners make the left driver bow to the right, so leftness loses in both geometries for different reasons [A01].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F03, sec05-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=34]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Driveway exits stop for everything while green lights still stop for nobody except whoever is already inside, entry caution versus earned passage [A01].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F02, sec05-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=34]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A02
Red-flashing responders command pull-over stops while blue, green and amber displayers earn only courtesy, and Move Over separately protects every stopped shoulder vehicle regardless of lights [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F09, sec05-F11, sec05-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=35]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A03
Every left stages near its own center yet lands differently, hugging the entered center on two-way arrivals and the left lane on one-way arrivals, one staging rule with two landing rules [A03].
Why it matters: group turns; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F16, sec05-F17 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=36]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A04
U-turns demand leftmost staging with green-arrow permission and long sight lines, yet die outright on expressways, in school zones, in city business districts and at posted signs [A04].
Why it matters: group turns; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F21, sec05-F22 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=37]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A05
Three-point turns choreograph right-stop, left-sweep, right-back and left-exit in that fixed order, the only maneuver in the chapter with a numbered script [A05].
Why it matters: group turns; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F21; confusables sec05-F23 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=38]
